LESSON: WOOD WORKSHOP

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: General
Strand: Foundations of Woodworking
Topic 1.2: Wood Workshop
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Wood Workshop, part of Foundations of Woodworking in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to have specific features in a wood workshop? 2. Why should a wood workshop have a proper layout?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe features of a wood workshop,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Wood Workshop together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening, and teamwork skills when brainstorming

features of the workshop and discussing safety measures.

• Digital Literacy: learner develops digital skills when interacting with and manipulating digital devices with assistive

technology to search for features of a wood workshop.

Values:
• Respect: learner appreciates diverse opinions of others as they discuss reasons for observing safety in the wood workshop.

• Unity: learner visit workshops as a team in the school and neighbourhood to identify different features of wood workshop.

• Patriotism: learner promotes good safety practices in the work environment

Pertinent Contemporary Issues (PCs)

• Safety and security: leaner observe safety for self and others in the workshop and road.

• Social cohesion: learner visit workshops in the school and community to identify different features

Suggested Resources: Digital devices such as; computer, laptop, smart phone, tablets among others, Charts and photos,

PPE’s

Key Concepts/Skills:

Illustrating the layout of a wood workshop
